usageNote: 口语短语！'serious reading'不是说书很严肃，是指那种沉下心来、认真啃书的感觉，跟刷手机那种casual阅读完全不同！

examples.en: On this long vacation, I finally got the chance to do some serious reading.
examples.zh: 这个长假我终于有机会好好读了些书。

examples.en: Retire early and you'll get the chance to do some serious reading you've always wanted.
examples.zh: 早点退休，你就能有机会认真读那些一直想读的书了。
